items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Dumb Luck with Moss and Frye.

ctx.x: Dumb Luck with Moss and Frye. I know you've heard of them. They were comedians. Moss was a straight man, and Frye was a comedian, and they were the biggest things in America at that time, comedians.
Now, this was before How Come?
